complete_original_provider_facts.fact: Entry normalizes each supplied stock element in place and deletes important already owned; menu references same array. canSell flag changes commands. Both ordinary exits clear entire temporary price table; errors/abnormal return have no guaranteed cleanup. No automatic stock reconstruction.

Shared input stock mutated/filtered. Nil greeting emits default then ordinary welcome; supplied greeting emits once. Exit Buy loop farewell then clear overlays then entry farewell, two normal goodbye messages.

complete_original_receiver_manual_object.meaning: Entry normalizes and filters the supplied stock array in place; ordinary exit clears the full temporary price overlay. Abnormal exit has no guaranteed cleanup. No stock reconstruction or shop-presence claim follows from PBS alone.

corrections_adopted.incorrect_fragment: Entry normalizes each supplied stock element in place
corrections_adopted.correct_meaning: pbPokemonMart does not replace/normalize every stock element in the entry method. It deletes important already-owned elements from the supplied array, then passes that same array through the screen. Strict GameData::Item.get inside predicates accepts supported identity inputs for lookup; lookup is not an assignment to the array. Any normalization in other callers is outside this complete method.

corrections_adopted.incorrect_fragment: Exit Buy loop farewell then clear overlays then entry farewell
corrections_adopted.correct_meaning: The complete screen pbBuyScreen ends by calling @scene.pbEndScene at504; it has no farewell or price-clear call. After normal screen return, pbBattlePointShop requests farewell1 at522, farewell2 at523, then clears overlays at524. Failure during either message can prevent clear; no ensure is present. Scene/native child behavior is not inferred from this screen body.

corrections_adopted.incorrect_fragment: Entry normalizes and filters the supplied stock array in place
corrections_adopted.correct_meaning: The receiver repeated the same unsupported normalization word. Only original-array filtering and continued alias use are supported by this complete entry method. This correction applies equally to provider and receiver prose; neither original object is silently rewritten.

root_operative_meaning: 普通入口只delete_if过滤重要且已持有项，没有把每个原stock元素替换为归一化值；查表内接受String/Symbol不等于数组赋值。
screen正常pbEndScene返回后wrapper依次两条farewell522/523，再clear_mart_prices524；screen自身pbBuyScreen没有farewell或clear。
任一farewell抛错可阻止后续clear，没有ensure/rollback保证；底层原生scene行为不由此方法推造。
